description: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for three different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 95000 to 125000, with tick labels spaced every 10000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, with tick labels spaced every 0.2 units. A magenta line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.22 at an iteration of 125000; it is a solid line with no markers. A dark blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.24 at an iteration of 125000; it is a solid line with no markers. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.25 at an iteration of 125000; it is a solid line with no markers. A red dashed line is present at a y-value of approximately 2.2, extending across the entire x-axis range.
